thread:
IncidentBot: PAGER: auth.introspect.okta — elevated 502s observed across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Paging on-call (severity: P1).

Alex R.: on it. getting logs now. seeing spikes starting ~09:22 UTC.

Priya S.: I can take triage. Alex, can you post the top error traces?

Alex R.: pasted the curl output from our introspect client: 
```
> POST https://okta.company.okta.com/oauth2/v1/introspect  
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
{"error":"server_error","error_description":"backend unavailable"}
```

Priya S.: yep 502 from Okta. looks like introspect is returning 502 for opaque tokens only. JWT local verification still fine.

Jamie L.: Customer reports: console login failing, some users hitting 401 on API calls. Support queue lighting up. ETA on mitigation?

Marta C.: product impact: console admin access is blocked in some regions; customers on Dedicated may be unable to create new sessions. We need an interim mitigation and a customer message.

Priya S.: mitigation options: 1) switch console routing to prefer JWT verification (if token is JWT) 2) enable short-lived local session fallback (accept currently cached introspect results for 5m) 3) route introspect calls to alternate Okta cluster/replica if available.

Alex R.: I pushed a quick query to see token types. 60% opaque tokens from web SSO, 40% JWT. That explains why some users can still use console.

Priya S.: I'm going to roll a config change to enable "introspect-cache-accept" for 5 minutes to avoid hard 401s while Okta recovers. Will also increase introspect client retry/backoff.

DeployBot: Deployment started: config/auth-introspect-fallback v1 -> infra-stage (canary 10%).

Alex R.: can we get a sample of the cached introspect payload we accept? need to ensure no stale revocations are accepted too long.

Priya S.: we're only accepting cached positive introspects for up to 300s and we still check revocation cache; if a token was explicitly revoked recent we won't accept. config snippet: 
```
auth.introspect.cache_ttl=300
auth.introspect.cache_accept_positive_only=true
auth.introspect.revocation_check=true
```

Jamie L.: publishing to customers now: short note to admins that console logins may intermittently fail; workaround: use existing sessions or wait ~5 minutes, we're applying a temporary fallback. Draft: "We are applying a temporary fallback to reduce login failures while Okta resolves an upstream issue."

Marta C.: +1 on messaging. please include affected regions and suggestion to retry and not to rotate keys.

Alex R.: DeployBot reports canary healthy at 10%. increasing to 50%. latency and error rate for auth-introspect calls dropped by ~80% for console flows.

Priya S.: Also opened ticket with Okta support and pasted tracebacks. Okta status page shows an ongoing incident in the EU cluster. I've added correlation IDs to the support ticket.

IncidentBot: Incident annotated: downstream vendor Okta - ongoing. severity remains P1 due to customer-facing auth failures.

Jamie L.: Support update posted to status page and we sent outbound to customers with active DEDicated contracts. Received one note asking for manual admin access — we can do one-off console bypass for critical customers.

Priya S.: I'll put a temporary feature flag that allows us to issue admin API tokens via secure flow for a small whitelist (support-runbook step). Doing that now.

Alex R.: handoff: I've got to step out for another pager. Priya, you're primary. Jamie, please own customer comms. Marta, keep product informed.

Priya S.: taking over. Current actions: 1) keep introspect-cache-fallback live 2) monitor Okta status + ticket 3) throttle retries to reduce load on Okta 4) prepare rollback plan.

Alex R.: thanks. added monitoring dashboard link and sample queries.

Priya S.: Okta support replied: internal gateway in eu-west-1 is overloaded, mitigation rolling, estimated recovery 20-40 minutes. They recommend clients add retries and exponential backoff.

Priya S.: reducing client concurrency to introspect to 10rps per instance and bumping retry to 5s backoff. patch deployed.

DeployBot: Deployment success: auth-introspect-fallback v1 -> infra-stage -> globally rolled.

Jamie L.: Customer comms updated to say mitigations applied and Okta reports partial recovery window. Sending follow-up to enterprise contacts.

Priya S.: monitoring shows error rate down 92%, console login failures trending to baseline. Still watching for any regressions.

Marta C.: product asks for a post-incident note: impacts, workaround, design action items (multi-idp failover, cached-introspect policy). I'll draft the RCA once incident closed.

IncidentBot: PAGER: on-call handoff in 30m.

Priya S.: handing to next oncall at 10:30 UTC: recommend keeping cache-accept until Okta fully green for +15m then gradually disable. If Okta confirms fix, we should remove fallback within 10 mins to avoid extended risk.

Jamie L.: support queue stabilizing. will keep monitoring and close customer EM once we confirm full recovery.

Priya S.: Okta status now shows "service degraded" -> partial recovery. continuing to watch.

Alex R.: back briefly — good work. Please capture timelines and config diffs for the postmortem.

IncidentBot: Incident status: monitoring. last update at 1845010200.
